tp1_reference.source_note: TP1 local regression train, read only; support/concentration comparison is descriptive, target meanings/scales differ.

provenance.grain: one row per record_id in provided task CSV; domain meaning of record UNKNOWN
provenance.cycle_basis: Sort distinct observed cycle_code values and divide them into three near-equal contiguous groups without consulting target. cycle_code larger means newer per local TP1 course PDF p.16; application to TP2 assumes same semantics.

tp1_target_comparison.interpretation: Support and concentration are comparable descriptively; target scales and definitions differ, so locations/ranks/KS comparisons between raw scores are not used.

within_cycle_percentile_diagnostic.diagnostic: Compare observed threat_rank with a within-cycle and pooled empirical average-rank percentile rounded to four decimals.
within_cycle_percentile_diagnostic.interpretation_limit: An exact numerical match is a distributional construction clue only. It does not prove the target-generation algorithm, causal meaning, or permission to reconstruct or use labels outside the official task.

thresholds.note: Fixed descriptive cutoffs; not selected against prediction or validation results.

interpretation_limits: Descriptive associations do not establish causality, statistical significance or prediction error.
TP2 has no model predictions here, so TP1 extreme under/overprediction rates must not be transferred to TP2.
An exact within-cycle percentile identity suggests a rank-like encoding but does not establish official semantics or target-generation lineage.
Cycle grouping assumes ordered code semantics; TP1 course material defines cycle_code as disclosure order, but TP2-specific calendar meaning remains unverified.
